findings.current: He’d been cut cleanly in two at the waist by Force. But the decay was so severe that I couldn’t determine anything beyond that…
findings.defect: The source states that Hwang Chung’s waist was severed in a single stroke or instant; “cut cleanly in two” does not preserve that one-action detail.
findings.rationale: 단숨에 specifies that the waist was severed at once, not merely that the body was cleanly divided.
findings.replacement: His waist was severed in a single stroke by Force. But the decay was so severe that I couldn’t determine anything beyond that…

findings.current: *Maybe we can even put him out front and have him lead us to the formation.*
findings.defect: “Have him lead us to the formation” gives the Third Fiend an active guiding role that the source does not establish. The source says to put him at the front and use that arrangement to locate the formation.
findings.rationale: 앞세워서 means putting him ahead or using him as the vanguard; it does not state that he knows the route or will lead the group.
findings.replacement: *Maybe we can even put him out front and use him to find the formation.*

findings.current: The Dongting Fisherman is only human. He must have had a shadow he showed no one.
findings.defect: The current wording adds both a “only human” limitation and deliberate concealment. The source says he is human too and had a shadow that no one had seen, without asserting that he intentionally withheld it.
findings.rationale: 역시 사람 means “human, too,” while 누구에게도 보이지 않았던 describes an unseen shadow in the passive, not necessarily one he chose not to show.
findings.replacement: The Dongting Fisherman is human, too. He must have had a shadow no one else could see.

summary: Mostly faithful, with three minor source-fidelity defects involving a dropped physical detail, an altered tactical mechanism, and added implications about the Dongting Fisherman’s hidden side.
